description: Surge 模块 · 来源 Surge
text:
#!name=Bilibili Helper.official
#!desc=Surge 模块 · 来源 Surge
#!author=ClashModule

[MITM]
hostname = grpc.biliapi.net, app.bilibili.com

[Script]
http-response ^https:\/\/app\.bilibili\.com\/x\/v2\/(splash|search\?|feed\/index), requires-body=1, max-size=-1, binary-body-mode=0, script-path=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Maasea/sgmodule/master/Script/Bilibili/dist/bilibili.helper.v2.beta.js
http-response ^https:\/\/grpc\.biliapi\.net\/bilibili\.community\.service\.dm\.v1\.DM\/DmView, requires-body=1, max-size=-1, binary-body-mode=1, script-path=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Maasea/sgmodule/master/Script/Bilibili/dist/bilibili.helper.beta.js
http-response ^https:\/\/grpc\.biliapi\.net\/bilibili\.app\.interface\.v1\.Teenagers\/ModeStatus, requires-body=1, binary-body-mode=1, max-size=-1, script-path=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Maasea/sgmodule/master/Script/Bilibili/dist/bilibili.helper.beta.js
http-response ^https:\/\/grpc\.biliapi\.net\/bilibili\.app\.(view|viewunite)\.v1\.View\/(View|ViewProgress)$, requires-body=1, binary-body-mode=1, max-size=-1, script-path=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Maasea/sgmodule/master/Script/Bilibili/dist/bilibili.helper.beta.js
http-response ^https:\/\/grpc\.biliapi\.net\/bilibili\.main\.community\.reply\.v1\.Reply\/MainList, requires-body=1, binary-body-mode=1, max-size=-1, script-path=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Maasea/sgmodule/master/Script/Bilibili/dist/bilibili.helper.beta.js
http-response ^https:\/\/grpc\.biliapi\.net\/bilibili\.polymer\.app\.search\.v1\.Search\/SearchAll$, requires-body=1, binary-body-mode=1, max-size=-1, script-path=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Maasea/sgmodule/master/Script/Bilibili/dist/bilibili.helper.beta.js
http-response ^https:\/\/grpc\.biliapi\.net\/bilibili\.app\.dynamic\.v2\.Dynamic\/DynAll$, requires-body=1, binary-body-mode=1, max-size=-1, script-path=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Maasea/sgmodule/master/Script/Bilibili/dist/bilibili.helper.beta.js
